fixes.explanation: Sinai is the spot, baker! Verse 1 says the LORD spoke to Moses in the Tent of Meeting in the Wilderness of Sinai. Moses is Israel's leader, and he's about to get a very big counting job. Picture it: the whole camp is out in the desert, and the LORD says, 'Take a census.' I'd be nervous, friend. I can't even count the crumbs on my counter without losing my place.

I see why you'd grab that one, friend, because Israel does camp in the plains of Moab later on (Numbers 22:1). But we're at the start of the book, and verse 1 says the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai. Right pin, different spot on the map. Moab's chapter hasn't come up yet, so it's still in the oven.
